step1.title: First Look at LiveViewJS w/ Donnie Flood
step1.description:
I spend a lot of time looking at declarative JavaScript frameworks. Looking at how they Server Render and are moving forward into a new hybrid future. But I've neglected looking at progress from backend technologies.

Donnie Flood, creator of LiveViewJS, joins us to show how we can use LiveViews inspired by Phoenix Liveview in a full JavaScript stack.

[0:00] Introduction
[8:50] Welcome Donnie Flood
[33:06] What is a LiveView?
[35:28] Stateful Servers?
[39:52] Do we always go to the Server on any Change?
[43:16] LiveViewJS Origins
[47:50] Routing
[56:09] Application entry
[1:02:57] The anatomy of a LiveView
[1:13:21] Data Structure and Diffing
[1:25:20] Leveraging Websockets
[1:35:00] Forms
[1:52:16] Does it Scale?
[2:06:06} Hackernews
[2:27:08] Exploring Client Performance
[3:04:28] Wrapping up with Donny
[3:09:35] Reflections on LiveViewJS
[3:29:04] This Week in JavaScript
